Backgrounds — Wave and Topography per style, and the five style-fixed backgrounds

Wave — every registered style, light and dark (Motir palette)

Every variation keeps the mark: the deep dip first and the crest later, the lines gathering around the main content (here the sign-in card), the colour band and the decision squares. Only shape, stroke, glow and motion change. The Wave draws no clear area: it gathers around the content instead.

Warm Editorial

warm-editorial

Shape: 46 fine lines bunched tight around the content. Stroke: 1px hairlines in the palette band, fading out away from the content, two band lines brighter across it. Glow: one faint blurred under-pass. Motion: slow drift.

Soft / Playful

soft-playful

Shape: 16 rounded lines with round caps and joins. Stroke: 2.6px in the palette band. Glow: a soft diffused blur under every line; decision squares are rounded 16px chips on a soft shadow. Motion: a gentle springy bob on top of the drift.

Swiss / Minimal-Flat

swiss-minimal-flat

Shape: 12 evenly spaced lines, no bunching. Stroke: 1px ink rules, one line in the accent at 1.5px with three 8px accent squares on it. Glow: none. Motion: slow drift.

Neo-Brutalism

neo-brutalism

Shape: 11 polylines with hard miter corners at a coarse knot spacing, three bands filled solid in the palette hues. Stroke: 3px ink with a 4px hard-offset shadow, every fourth line in the accent; 18px squares with hard offset blocks. Glow: none. Motion: steps twice a second.

Glassmorphism

glassmorphism

Shape: 13 lines; every third pair encloses a frosted ribbon of a palette hue. Stroke: 1px light glass edges over a faint ink underline, one accent line. Glow: the ribbons are blurred 8px; decision squares are frosted 18px tiles with a hairline edge. Motion: slow glide.

Cybercore / Y2K

cybercore-y2k

Shape: the lines quantised to a 6px pixel grid, near lines with an RGB split (teal left, accent right). Stroke: filled pixels in the first hue, far lines fainter. Glow: a hue bloom in dark mode, scanlines over everything. Motion: pixel comets run along five lines.

Aurora

aurora

Shape: 24 lines bunched around the content, two band lines at 3px. Stroke: 1.4px in the palette band. Glow: every line lit from within (16px glow in dark mode with additive light, 10px in light); glowing rounded squares. Motion: very slow ambient drift.

3D / Immersive

3d-immersive

Shape: the lines split into three depth planes: far, middle, near. Stroke: 0.8px faint ink far, 1.4px band middle, 2.6px band near. Glow: the near plane seated on a deep 8px drop shadow; decision squares are small extruded cubes. Motion: the planes parallax at different speeds.

Neumorphism

neumorphism

Shape: 9 soft grooves moulded into the page. Stroke: 4px in the page colour with a light highlight top-left and a soft shade bottom-right, one band line through the middle. Glow: none; decision squares are raised pebbles with a dual soft shadow. Motion: slow drift.

Hand-Drawn / Indie

hand-drawn-indie

Shape: 20 jittered pencil lines, each drawn twice. Stroke: 1.3px and 0.8px in ink, two lines in the accent; decision squares as sketched outlines. Glow: none. Motion: the line boils (re-jitters) eight times a second.

Retrofuturism

retrofuturism

Shape: 14 lines held above a horizon, with a static receding accent grid floor and a horizon glow band below the content. Stroke: 1.4px in the palette band, two band lines at 2.6px. Glow: a neon glow in dark mode; chrome capsule decision marks. Motion: the lines drift slowly; the grid and horizon never move.

Dense / Pro

dense-pro

Shape: 64 hairlines packed close around the content. Stroke: 0.6px ink, two band lines at 1px; 6px decision squares. Glow: none. Motion: drift.

High-Contrast / Accessible

high-contrast-accessible

Shape: 8 well-spaced lines. Stroke: 2px ink, the two band lines 3px solid in the accent and the second hue; 14px squares with a 2px ink edge. Glow: none. Motion: none, it is one still frame.

Tonal / Elevated

tonal-elevated

Shape: 10 lines with the bands between them filled as tonal rungs, a step closer to the ink the nearer they are to the content, one band in the first hue. Stroke: 1px hairline on every line. Glow: each rung seated by a soft neutral shadow; tonal tiles for squares. Motion: calm drift.

Claymorphism

claymorphism

Shape: 7 fat clay tubes with round caps, two in the palette hues and the rest neutral clay. Stroke: a tube about 4.5% of the box high with a light band on its top and a shade band on its bottom. Glow: one soft outer drop; decision marks are clay blobs. Motion: drift with a slow squish (the amplitude breathes).

Bento

bento

Shape: the box cut into rounded tiles (4 × 3) with even gutters; the lines run through every tile, one hero tile tinted with the first hue and its lines stronger. Stroke: 1px in the palette band, 1.6px in the hero tile. Glow: none. Motion: the tiles stay still, only the lines inside them drift.

Editorial Print / Newspaper

editorial-print

Shape: 26 lines over vertical column rules. Stroke: 1px ink, two 2px ink section rules, one 1.5px accent line; 8px ink and accent squares. Glow: none. Motion: advances once a second, set rather than animated.

Art Deco

art-deco

Shape: a static sunburst fanning up from under the content, and every other line drawn as a double rule. Stroke: a 2px metal rule plus a 1px rule 4px below, band lines in the hues; decision marks are stepped-corner plates with an inner rule. Glow: none. Motion: mechanical, four steps a second.

Memphis

memphis

Shape: zigzag and squiggle lines over a static Bacterio texture of staggered hue dots and a diagonal hatch strip. Stroke: 2.5px ink on a 3px hard-offset accent block, the band lines 4px in the hues; squares stacked as ink, accent and hue blocks. Glow: none. Motion: fast drift.

Topography — every registered style, light and dark (Motir palette)

One seeded height field drifting slowly, drawn as contour lines in each style’s own hand. Like every background except the Wave, it fades to the page colour behind the main content (the shipped clear area).

Warm Editorial

warm-editorial

Shape: 14 interpolated contour levels at a fine 7px grid. Stroke: 1px ink hairlines, every third level in the palette band. Glow: none. Motion: slow drift.

Soft / Playful

soft-playful

Shape: 8 levels with every other terrace washed in a faint palette tint. Stroke: 2.6px round-capped lines cycling the three palette hues. Glow: none. Motion: drift with a slow bob.

Swiss / Minimal-Flat

swiss-minimal-flat

Shape: 7 levels on an 8px grid. Stroke: 1px ink rules, one 1.5px accent level. Glow: none. Motion: slow drift.

Neo-Brutalism

neo-brutalism

Shape: 5 un-interpolated levels on a coarse 22px grid, with solid hue blocks in the peaks, valleys and the mid band. Stroke: 3px square-capped ink on a 4px hard offset. Glow: none. Motion: steps once a second.

Glassmorphism

glassmorphism

Shape: 7 levels as stacked translucent terraces, each a step further into the palette hues, blurred 3px. Stroke: 1.2px light glass edge with a faint ink underline. Glow: the terrace blur. Motion: slow drift.

Cybercore / Y2K

cybercore-y2k

Shape: 9 levels as pixel cells on a 6px grid. Stroke: cells cycling the three hues, every third level solid. Glow: bloom on the solid levels in dark mode, scanlines. Motion: drift.

Aurora

aurora

Shape: 10 levels, alternate levels brighter. Stroke: 1.8px and 1px in the palette band. Glow: a 14px glow with additive light in dark mode, 8px in light. Motion: half-speed drift.

3D / Immersive

3d-immersive

Shape: 7 levels lifted one step higher each, so the map reads as raised relief. Stroke: levels thicken as they rise, alternating band and ink. Glow: a drop shadow under every level. Motion: drift.

Neumorphism

neumorphism

Shape: 6 levels as moulded grooves. Stroke: 4px page colour with highlight and shade pairs, one band level. Glow: none. Motion: drift.

Hand-Drawn / Indie

hand-drawn-indie

Shape: 10 levels drawn twice with jitter. Stroke: ink pencil, one accent level. Glow: none. Motion: boils eight times a second.

Retrofuturism

retrofuturism

Shape: 8 levels above the same static horizon and grid floor. Stroke: alternating 1.6px and 1px in the palette band. Glow: neon glow in dark mode. Motion: slow drift; the floor is static.

Dense / Pro

dense-pro

Shape: 22 levels on a fine 6px grid. Stroke: 0.6px ink, every fifth index level at 1px in the band. Glow: none. Motion: drift.

High-Contrast / Accessible

high-contrast-accessible

Shape: 5 levels on a 12px grid. Stroke: 2px ink, one 3px accent index level. Glow: none. Motion: none, one still frame.

Tonal / Elevated

tonal-elevated

Shape: 6 levels as flat tonal terraces, 4% further toward the ink per level. Stroke: 1px hairline on a soft shadow, one level in the first hue. Glow: none. Motion: drift.

Claymorphism

claymorphism

Shape: 5 levels as clay tubes, two in hues. Stroke: 9px tubes with a top highlight. Glow: a soft drop under each tube. Motion: drift.

Bento

bento

Shape: contours clipped into the same tile grid, one hero tile tinted with the second hue. Stroke: ink hairlines, every third level and the hero tile in the band. Glow: none. Motion: drift inside still tiles.

Editorial Print / Newspaper

editorial-print

Shape: 12 levels over column rules. Stroke: 1px ink, every fourth level a 2px ink rule, one accent level. Glow: none. Motion: advances once a second.

Art Deco

art-deco

Shape: 6 un-interpolated, machined levels on a 14px grid. Stroke: 2px metal plus a 1px inner rule 4px below, one level in the first hue. Glow: none. Motion: four steps a second.

Memphis

memphis

Shape: 5 levels with alternate terraces filled solid in the hues, over staggered ink dots. Stroke: 2.5px ink on a 3px hard-offset accent. Glow: none. Motion: drift.

The five style-fixed backgrounds — the shipped drawers, light and dark

These five draw the same under every style and follow only palette and mode. Each tile runs the drawer @motir/design-system ships (MOTIR-11604, MOTIR-11616) with the shipped clear area behind the card, shown here under Warm Editorial.

Aurora

aurora

Seven soft bands of light rolling across the box, their colour cycling slowly through the palette hues; stronger in dark mode.

Cyclic CA

cyclic

Sixteen states on a ramp across the palette hues; a cell takes the next state when a neighbour holds it, so spirals form and turn. Opens formed.

Brian's Brain

brian

Firing cells in the decision colour, dying cells a faint decision colour; reseeds if activity drops below 0.5%.

Day & Night

daynight

Day & Night islands in a faint decision colour; a few random flips per step keep their edges moving.

Rule 110

rule110

A random first row, the screen filled before the first frame, scrolling up; cells coloured by a palette ramp across the width.
